7.2.19.8 Trigger: T_CC_STOPPED_TIMEOUT
[SWS_CanSM_00630]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Can_01142, SRS_Can_01145
⌈After a timeout of CANSM_MODEREQ_REPEAT_TIME (ref. to [ECUC_CanSM_00336])
for all supposed controller stopped mode indications (ref. to [SWS_CanSM_00629]),
this condition shall trigger the sub state machine CANSM_BSM_WUVALIDATION of the
respective network with T_CC_STOPPED_TIMEOUT.⌋
